key_decisions: MPI-404: the models root stays ENGINE-OWNED (user, 2026-08-05). The hero must not assert a count it cannot compute. An app-level models root is a product card of its own if ever wanted.

MPI-410 root, MEASURED not guessed: mainWindow's ready-to-show fires on Chromium's network error page, so the splash was closed 1.1s BEFORE Express bound. did-finish-load fires for the error page too and getURL() keeps the target URL - only did-navigate separates them. The splash was never starved (81ms to load), so the brief's candidate 2 is dead.

MPI-412 root: indeterminate was a per-TICK flag, so the display mode flipped on whichever dep ticked last. routes/install/computeProgress.js already held the correct job-level rule, was tested by MPI-276, and was required by NOTHING - the live path kept a divergent copy. Only isNodeTickPending is wired in so far; adopting computeProgress wholesale would change verify/phase semantics for the Model Library and needs its own card.

MPI-416 split by Gate C: the symlink half shipped, the Xcode CLT half is deferred behind a known-issue line. Do NOT start the tarball-instead-of-clone fix from the card text - CLT also supplies clang, so killing git may only move the dialog later. Verify that first.

MPI-433 stays date-gated (maturity blocked). The audit found THREE more single-route deps than that card knew about - the MPI-420 preview decoders - and they are permanently noMirror by nature, not by licence timing. Do not fold them into MPI-433's rollback.
Gate B runs AFTER the bump on purpose: MPI-249 tests the ARTIFACT, and verifying a dev checkout does not verify a build.
constraints: A peer agent commits into this tree LIVE. It touched MPI-449's brief and events this session. Re-status right before committing and commit ONLY your own paths; board.json and the global events.jsonl are co-owned and currently hold uncommitted work from both sides.
Board timestamps run AHEAD of the real clock (peer sessions on a VPN exit node). Never correct a peer timestamp, never regress board.json updated_at. This session stamped up to 2026-08-05T15:05:00Z.

NEVER add a dep whose filename starts with lighttaew - ComfyUI #13366 corrupts real generations on the Wan21/Wan22/Qwen family. The bytes ARE staged on R2, so re-adding the dep is the whole job the day PR #13383 lands in our engine version.
MPI-454 (Composite Place) is NOT in this umbrella - a peer's feature card, blocked by MPI-377, which 1.4 explicitly excludes.
Run validate_board.py as 'validate_board.py .' from the REPO ROOT and never through a pipe. It passes today, so a non-zero exit is your own violation.

Live checks that are the USER's, not an agent's: MPI-453 (Wan 2.2 with only i2v installed), MPI-420 (one Klein + one Wan generation), MPI-374 (a full restart), MPI-404 (a cloud-only first run: hero reads a dash, no Stage-all switch without a key), MPI-410's strobe half (a real engine install).
